title: AWS CEO Matt Garman: 'Built Together' — Amazon pledges $1B to data center communities (2026-10-02)
why: PILO-e9ad8b. Primary corporate document, Garman's own memo. Frames the buildout as the Interstate Highway System, pledges $1B over five years to host communities, and answers the movement's grievances as numbered myths (water, rates, generators). Names no resident, official or group. Crucially it launders the China-astroturf claim into industry argument: 'widespread reports of various countries intentionally seeding misinformation in the U.S. about data centers to trick us into slowing down. Right now there are over 100 data center moratoriums being considered.' The frame the assignment refuses to adopt is now on the other side's letterhead, which makes it reportable as their position.
